protocol.status: Frozen before model access: visible readout validation only
protocol.question: Does a broader fixed lexical readout distinguish fresh visible fruit/music descriptions from each other and paired neutral descriptions?
protocol.scope: 48 ordinary next-token forwards; no donors, activation hooks, perturbations, training, or self-monitoring evaluation.
protocol.token_policy: Use deduplicated bare and leading-space single-token spellings. Every word must have at least one such spelling; otherwise stop before forwards. Save all encodings and selected IDs. Banks must be disjoint. No truncating multi-token words to their first token.
protocol.scoring: Sum full-vocabulary next-token probabilities within each fixed bank; log(fruit mass / music mass) in natural-log units. For music reverse the sign. Subtract the same-template paired neutral score to quantify content selectivity. Report absolute bank mass and greedy-token coverage as well.
protocol.decision: Require every gate for both concepts and both templates. Zero scores/deltas count as failures. Completion never starts another protocol. Retain a failed result without changing this vocabulary or these thresholds.
protocol.analysis: Descriptive feasibility validation on eight matched triplets with two templates (48 forwards). Templates are repeated measures, not independent replications; no p-values, confidence intervals, or consciousness inference.
protocol.limits: The broader vocabulary was designed after seeing pilot-003 and includes its observed category words. These 24 sentences are new, but are hand-authored controls, not an independently sampled benchmark. Vocabulary remains incomplete and token-bank sizes can differ; paired neutral subtraction addresses baseline preference only. Passing does not validate hidden intervention detection.
